NeoSkriptGuiSecCreateGUI.name: Create/Edit GUI
description: Makes a GUI from an inventory, or edits one. With an id it's a global GUI, kept until it's deleted; without one, it goes once nobody has it open.
examples:
create a gui with virtual chest inventory with 3 rows named "Shop":
	make gui slot 13 with diamond:
		send "Clicked!" to player
open the last gui to player

NeoSkriptGuiSecMakeSlot.name: Make GUI Slot
description: Puts an item in slots of the GUI, by number or by a character of its shape, with code to run when it's clicked. The code keeps the local variables as they were: one copy, shared by every click.
examples:
make gui slot 0 with dirt named "Home":
	teleport player to {home::%player's uuid%}
make next gui with removable diamond

NeoSkriptGuiEffRemoveSlot.name: Remove GUI Slot
description: Empties slots of the GUI.
examples: remove gui slot 10
remove all of the gui slots

NeoSkriptGuiSecOpen.name: GUI Open
description: Code that runs when a player opens the GUI.
examples:
run on gui open:
	send "Welcome!" to player

NeoSkriptGuiSecClose.name: GUI Close
description: Code that runs when a player closes the GUI. 'cancel the gui closing' opens it again.
examples:
run on gui close:
	send "Bye!" to player

NeoSkriptGuiSecSlotChange.name: GUI Slot Change
description: Code that runs when a player changes what's in a slot that can be changed.
examples:
run when slot 4 changes:
	send "Thanks!" to player

NeoSkriptGuiEffCancelClose.name: Cancel GUI Close
description: In a GUI close section: the GUI opens again.
examples:
run on gui close:
	cancel the gui closing

NeoSkriptGuiEffLock.name: Lock/Unlock GUI
description: Whether players can take items from the GUI's slots without code.
examples: unlock the player's gui

NeoSkriptGuiEffShowGUI.name: Show GUI
description: Opens a GUI for players.
examples: show the last gui to player

NeoSkriptGuiCondHasGUI.name: Has GUI
description: Whether players have a GUI open.
examples: if player has a gui open:

NeoSkriptGuiCondIsLocked.name: Is GUI Locked
description: Whether a GUI is locked.
examples: if the player's gui is locked:

NeoSkriptGuiExprGUI.name: GUI of Player
description: The GUI a player has open.
examples:
edit the player's gui:
	make gui slot 1 with dirt

NeoSkriptGuiExprGUIValues.name: GUI Values
description: Values of the click in a slot's code, and of the GUI: its slot, raw slot, hotbar slot, inventory, inventory action, click type, cursor item, clicked item (which can be set), slot type, player, viewers and slot id. In open and close code, only the GUI, inventory, player and viewers.
examples:
make gui 10 with water bucket:
	set the gui clicked item to lava bucket

NeoSkriptGuiExprGUIWithId.name: GUI with ID
description: A global GUI, by its id.
examples: open the gui with the id "menu" to player

NeoSkriptGuiExprGlobalGUIs.name: All Global GUIs
description: Every global GUI.
examples: broadcast "%size of global guis%"

NeoSkriptGuiExprLastGUI.name: Last GUI
description: The GUI made or edited last in this trigger.
examples: open the last created gui to player

NeoSkriptGuiExprId.name: GUI ID
description: A GUI's id. Setting it makes it global.
examples: set the id of the player's gui to "menu"

NeoSkriptGuiExprLayout.name: GUI Layout
description: A GUI's shape, which names its slots by characters.
examples: set the layout of the player's gui to "xxxxxxxxx", "x-------x" and "xxxxxxxxx"

NeoSkriptGuiExprLockStatus.name: GUI Lock Status
description: Deprecated: use 'lock' and 'is locked'.
examples: set the lock status of the player's gui to true

NeoSkriptGuiExprNextSlot.name: Next GUI Slot
description: The next slot of a GUI not made yet, as a character of its shape.
examples: make the next gui slot with dirt named "Slot %the next gui slot%"

NeoSkriptGuiExprPaginatedList.name: Paginated List
description: Pages of a list: page 2 with 10 values per page is values 11 to 20.
examples: set {_page::*} to page 2 of {_items::*} with 36 values

NeoSkriptGuiExprVirtualInventory.name: Virtual Inventory
description: A new inventory for a GUI.
examples: create a gui with virtual chest inventory with 3 rows named "My GUI"
